opening.argument: The segment presents an ordinary Taco Bell promotion through a local newscast format: viewers are told that “All of America gets a free taco” and can claim it during a clearly defined pickup window, from 2 p.m. until 6 p.m. The promotion is expressly identified as “Taco Bell's steal a base, steal a taco promotion,” while the description identifies the program as a “5 a.m. newscast.” The audience action is limited to in-person redemption of a free Doritos Locos taco; nothing described requires payment, investment, credential submission, or financial participation.

citations.quote: All of America gets a free taco.
You can pick yours up from 2 p.m. until 6 p.m. today.
